csv_project_name: Engineering design for SR-20/Cascade Trail Phase 2A
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Sedro-Woolley ( City ) is seeking submittals from firms interested in providing services to the Public Works Department for the SR20/Cascade Trail West Phase 2A STPUS-0020(200). The successful firm will have experience with expertise in Federal Aid multimodal pedestrian facility project design, construction, permitting, right of way acquisition and construction services. This project is the latest effort to provide a multi-modal pedestrian trail system roughly parallel to SR20 on a separated shared use path system. The Sedro-Woolley Comprehensive Plan has long identified this project as a needed improvement making this vital corridor more accessible for pedestrians and bicyclists. This route is designated as US Bike Route 10 and forms a part of the Cascade Trail system. The Cascade Trail Phase 2A project will add an additional 0.57 miles to the trail starting at Hodgin Road and ending at Holtcamp. Future projects will extend the multimodal pedestrian trail further to the west and eventual link Burlington, Sedro-Woolley and Concrete, WA.
